items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: We didn't have no trouble with Freddie Jenkins. I used to get on him on account of for playing certain things that he wasn't supposed to be playing

ctx.x: What do you remember about Freddie Jenkins?

Freddie Jenkins? Well, you know, he was a showman more than anything else. He played a little tambourine and then maracas and everything; he did everything; he was a showoff, boy. We didn't have no trouble with Freddie Jenkins. I used to get on him on account of for playing certain things that he wasn't supposed to be playing; just like Rex -- and clowning so much, with Duke, but I guess that's what he wanted anyhow.
The Duke kind of liked individualists, didn't he? I mean people who were different?
